row.conditions_en: Migrate by original version, interface and removal plan; do not replace every API uniformly.
row.conditions_zh: 按条目中的原版本、接口与删除计划迁移，不能统一替换所有 API。
row.fact_en: The 9.1.1 notes repeat quantization APIs marked deprecated in CANN 8.5.0: aclnnQuantMatmul / V2 / V3 / V4 are replaced by V5; aclnnWeightQuantBatchMatmul by V3.
row.fact_zh: 9.1.1 补丁说明重列 CANN 8.5.0 已标记废弃的量化接口：aclnnQuantMatmul / V2 / V3 / V4 替换为 V5；aclnnWeightQuantBatchMatmul 替换为 V3。
row.title_en: Legacy quantization API deprecation and replacement
row.title_zh: 旧量化接口的废弃与替换

row.conditions_en: This table only; master is not equivalent to v9.1.1.
row.conditions_zh: 仅该配套表范围；不假定 master 等价于 v9.1.1。
row.fact_en: cann-ops-transformer 9.1.1 maps to v9.1.1; the table lists CANN 9.1.x, 9.0.x and 8.5.2.
row.fact_zh: cann-ops-transformer 9.1.1 对应源码标签 v9.1.1；配套表列出 CANN 9.1.x、9.0.x、8.5.2。
row.locator: CANN ops combination-package subpackage compatibility table

row.conditions_en: Project-log evidence only; check Q/K/V types, shapes and package availability against matching-tag documentation.
row.conditions_zh: 仅确认项目记录；具体 Q/K/V 数据类型、形状和发布包须按配套标签文档核对。
row.fact_en: The project log states that fused_infer_attention_score supports A5 MXFP8 full quantization.
row.fact_zh: 项目记录指出 fused_infer_attention_score 在 A5 上支持 MXFP8 全量化。

row.conditions_en: DSV4 Top-K path; sparse candidate access is not structured pruning.
row.conditions_zh: DSV4 Top-K 路径；不将候选访问稀疏归为结构化剪枝。
row.fact_en: Adds lightning_indexer_v2, quant_lightning_indexer_v2 and metadata.
row.fact_zh: 增加 lightning_indexer_v2 与 quant_lightning_indexer_v2 及 metadata。

row.conditions_en: Model/hardware restricted; source compatibility must still be checked.
row.conditions_zh: 模型与硬件限定；源码配套仍须核对。
row.fact_en: Adds A5 sparse_flash_mla, mixed_quant_sparse_flash_mla and metadata for DSV4.
row.fact_zh: A5 增加 sparse_flash_mla、mixed_quant_sparse_flash_mla 及 metadata，面向 DSV4。

row.conditions_en: Keep regular and experimental directories distinct; verify released tags separately.
row.conditions_zh: 正式目录与 experimental 分开；版本标签可用性待逐项确认。
row.fact_en: Adds dedicated A5 fully quantized Dense Attention; the experimental counterpart supports fully quantized MxFP4.
row.fact_zh: A5 新增 Dense Attention 全量化专用算子；experimental 同名算子支持 MxFP4 全量化。

row.conditions_en: The directory reports CANN 9.2 TensorV2 and an opbase restriction on CANN 9.1.
row.conditions_zh: 目录披露 CANN 9.2 TensorV2；CANN 9.1 有 opbase 限制。
row.fact_en: The directory records passing actual strides into addressing and checking layout bounds to fix contiguous-layout assumptions.
row.fact_zh: 目录记录将真实 stride 传至地址计算并检查布局边界，修复按连续布局寻址的问题。

row.conditions_en: MXFP8 high-precision window path; release-package support unconfirmed.
row.conditions_zh: MXFP8 高精窗口路径；发布包支持未确认。
row.fact_en: Directory changes add vTailOptional, blockTableTailOptional and sequsedKvTailOptional, with BF16 tail storage.
row.fact_zh: 目录变更扩展 vTailOptional、blockTableTailOptional、sequsedKvTailOptional 三项输入，尾块使用 BF16。

row.conditions_en: Maintenance dependency changes, not an algorithmic innovation.
row.conditions_zh: 维护分支的依赖变更，不是算法创新。
row.fact_en: Pins memfabric_hybrid and memcache_hybrid to 1.2.0.
row.fact_zh: memfabric_hybrid 与 memcache_hybrid 均锁定 1.2.0。

row.conditions_en: DP-aligned dummy runs; this is not a KV compression-ratio gain.
row.conditions_zh: DP 对齐 dummy run 场景；不是 KV 压缩比例提升。
row.fact_en: Invalidates per-group KV slot mappings before Attention metadata to fix stale writes in DP-aligned dummy runs.
row.fact_zh: 构造 Attention metadata 前使每组 KV slot mapping 失效，修复 DP 对齐 dummy run 的陈旧写入。

row.conditions_en: The fixes have distinct conditions; do not extend them to all hardware.
row.conditions_zh: 两项修复各有场景；不要推及所有硬件。
row.fact_en: Fixes MTP overlay prefix-cache accuracy on 300I DUO and W8A8 MXFP8 buffers during RL weight reload in ACL Graph.
row.fact_zh: 修复 300I DUO 的 MTP overlay prefix-cache 精度，并稳定 ACL Graph 下 RL 权重重载的 W8A8 MXFP8 缓冲。
row.title_en: Quantized buffers and Prefix Cache accuracy
row.title_zh: 量化缓冲与 Prefix Cache 精度

row.conditions_en: Target-path communication optimization; no universal compression multiplier is reported.
row.conditions_zh: 这是目标路径的通信优化；原文没有给出可通用于所有模型的压缩倍数。
row.fact_en: MiniMax-M3 decode TP communication exchanges index queries and local Top-K candidates instead of full index KV data.
row.fact_zh: MiniMax-M3 解码的 TP 通信改为交换索引查询与局部 Top-K 候选，替代完整索引 KV 数据交换。

row.conditions_en: This is an advance notice; distinguish current and later releases.
row.conditions_zh: 这是预告；按当前候选版与后续版本分别处理。
row.fact_en: Future deprecation of enable_sparse_sfa_c8/enable_sparse_li_c8 in favor of KV/indexer dtype options.
row.fact_zh: 后续废弃 enable_sparse_sfa_c8 / enable_sparse_li_c8，改用 KV 与 indexer dtype 参数。

row.conditions_en: Do not reinterpret BF16 as INT8 KV; declared release scope only.
row.conditions_zh: BF16 描述不能替换成 INT8 KV；仅发布矩阵范围。
row.fact_en: The 950DT path integrates SparseFlashMla BF16 KV sparse Attention with DSpark/DSA-CP.
row.fact_zh: 950DT 路径接入 SparseFlashMla BF16 KV 稀疏 Attention 与 DSpark/DSA-CP。

row.conditions_en: Fusion is execution optimization, not independently compression.
row.conditions_zh: 算子融合属于执行优化，不单独视为压缩。
row.fact_en: Integrates GMM-SiTU for supported MoE paths.
row.fact_zh: 接入 GMM-SiTU，用于受支持的 MoE 计算路径。

row.conditions_en: Declared model and 950DT scope only; this is cache execution/layout support, not a quantization ratio.
row.conditions_zh: 限候选版声明的模型与 950DT 路径；这是缓存执行/布局适配，不单独代表量化压缩率。
row.fact_en: DeepSeek-V4-Flash adds layerwise KV Cache reuse for physical layers with multiple main-cache specifications.
row.fact_zh: DeepSeek-V4-Flash 增加逐层 KV Cache 复用，支持同一物理层具有多个主缓存规格。
row.title_zh: 逐层 KV Cache 复用

row.conditions_en: Atlas 800 A3 or 950DT; configure formats per the official matrix.
row.conditions_zh: Atlas 800 A3 或 950DT；各格式按官方模型矩阵配置。
row.fact_en: Adds W8A8/MXFP8; FP8 KV mode uses FP8 E4M3 for MSA/index caches while dense GQA remains BF16 by default.
row.fact_zh: 增加 W8A8 / MXFP8；fp8 KV 配置使 MSA 与索引缓存使用 FP8 E4M3，Dense GQA 默认仍是 BF16。

row.conditions_en: Not immediate removal from earlier releases; consult the complete official list and effective version.
row.conditions_zh: 当前候选版不立即删除这些早期版本能力；完整清单及生效版本以官方原文为准。
row.fact_en: The notes announce future removal of listed DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi and selected MiniMax/Qwen models from active maintenance, with model-specific CI/nightly coverage ending once effective.
row.fact_zh: 发布说明预告 DeepSeek-R1/V3.1/V3.2、GLM-4.7/5、Kimi-K2 系列、部分 MiniMax/Qwen 等模型将退出活跃维护集合；生效后不再维护相应 CI 与 nightly 测试。
row.locator: Deprecation and Configuration Changes: Upcoming model deprecations

row.conditions_en: SmoothQuant handles outliers; check documented long-sequence / MLA scope for FA3.
row.conditions_zh: SmoothQuant 是离群值处理；FA3 适用范围按长序列 / MLA 文档核对。
row.fact_en: Docs list weight–activation rescaling and per-head INT8 Attention activation quantization.
row.fact_zh: 文档列出权重—激活协同缩放，以及 Attention 激活的 per-head INT8 量化。

row.conditions_en: These are documented internal-test adaptations; check dependencies per model example.
row.conditions_zh: 属于文档记录的内测适配，需按模型案例核对依赖。
row.fact_en: Version notes list Qwen3-Coder-480B W4A8, Qwen3.5 MoE W8A8, GLM-5 W4A8 and Omni model W8A8.
row.fact_zh: 版本说明列出 Qwen3-Coder-480B W4A8、Qwen3.5 MoE W8A8、GLM-5 W4A8 及 Omni 模型 W8A8。

row.conditions_en: No universal accuracy or speedup result is provided; no invented numbers.
row.conditions_zh: 未列统一精度或加速收益，不能编造效果数字。
row.fact_en: Notes record autotuning improvements and entry-point custom practice directories for model_adapter extensibility.
row.fact_zh: 文档记录自动调优优化及 entry point 自定义 practice 目录的 model_adapter 插件化基础。

row.conditions_en: Check cache bit width, granularity, model and export format; weight quantization does not imply cache quantization.
row.conditions_zh: 核对 C 位宽、缓存粒度、模型和下游格式，不能由权重量化推断缓存已量化。
row.fact_en: KVCache Quant targets low-precision representations of persistent K/V caches.
row.fact_zh: KVCache Quant 面向持久 K/V 缓存的低精度表示。
row.locator: KVCache Quant / 词条定义与适用场景

row.conditions_en: Formats are not interchangeable; compressed-tensors currently lists static/dynamic W8A8 without KV cache.
row.conditions_zh: 格式不可互换；compressed-tensors 当前仅列静态 / 动态 W8A8，不支持 KV Cache。
row.fact_en: Official docs distinguish formats for Ascend inference, the HF ecosystem and multimodal generation.
row.fact_zh: 官方将三种格式分别面向昇腾推理、HF 生态和多模态生成。
row.locator: 量化格式 / 格式地图与三种格式如何区分

row.conditions_en: Here SVDQuant targets diffusion models; sparse gains require sparse execution and cannot be extrapolated to LLMs or dense kernels.
row.conditions_zh: SVDQuant 在此文档面向扩散模型；稀疏收益需稀疏执行支持，不能直接外推到 LLM 或稠密核。
row.fact_en: The overview lists ADMM-based FloatSparse and SVDQuant low-rank residual plus quantization.
row.fact_zh: 官方总览列出 FloatSparse 的 ADMM 稀疏化与 SVDQuant 的低秩残差、量化组合。
row.title_en: Sparse and low-rank combinations: FloatSparse / SVDQuant

row.conditions_en: Calibration activations do not imply quantized activations; check actual W/A settings.
row.conditions_zh: 激活用于校准不等于激活已量化；核对实际 W/A 配置。
row.fact_en: The overview lists GPTQ column-wise optimization and error compensation, and AWQ activation-statistics scaling search.
row.fact_zh: 算法总览列出 GPTQ 逐列优化与误差补偿，以及 AWQ 基于激活统计的缩放搜索。
